accessibility.textAlternative: The seed library. When the dry season ended, Satta found three empty seed tins beside the school garden. She asked each family to bring a small share of seeds. On Friday, the class labelled the tins and wrote down who had contributed. A younger pupil worried that only families with money could help. Satta pointed to the list. Some families had given seeds, some had cleaned tins, and others had taught the class when to plant. By the next week, every pupil could borrow seeds and promise to return some after the harvest.
